unreleased.why: Local build of the unified-chart-geometry work, vendored ahead of a release so it can be tested on real devices. `npm run meteogram:check` passes (it only compares the committed bundle to sha256 above), but `npm run meteogram:sync` CANNOT restore this file — there is no published release to download it from.
unreleased.toFinish: Push the branch, merge, tag + publish the release with this asset, then set version/tag/commit/sha256 to the published values and re-run `npm run meteogram:sync` to confirm the download matches.
